title: values
$comment: DELIBERATELY OPEN: this schema bounds ONE knob, database.migrationLockTimeoutSeconds (ledger 814, ADR-0837), and declares nothing else, so every other value stays exactly as unvalidated as it was. A closed schema covering the whole chart is ledger 990's job, not this one's. The bound's arithmetic is in chart/values.yaml beside the value.

migrationLockTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a replica waits for another one's migration before failing its boot. Rendered as DB_MIGRATION_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, read with no fallback. 1 because GET_LOCK with 0 never waits and with a negative wait never takes the lock; 590 because the Deployment's default progressDeadlineSeconds is 600 and the readiness ramp is 6s.
